latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of memory-fusion-lite — a lightweight memory management enhancement for Dreaming users.

- Implements three core features from memory-fusion: daily incremental scan (A′ 7-day rolling zone), anti-recursion safeguards, and weekly memory governance.
- Adds an incremental Python script for session scanning and automated extraction.
- Maintains an automatically managed 7-day rolling update section in MEMORY.md, with weekly classification and promotion.
- Provides manual and scheduled cron triggers for daily and weekly memory operations.
- Designed to complement Dreaming; requires Dreaming to be enabled and specific workspace directories to exist.
